summary: Allocates a per-object dispatch state and per-object 256-byte buffers. Allocates an 84-byte state block via the allocator vtable at this+0x4, stores it at this+0x198, and seeds its first entry with FAILOverviewSaysFIRCrossfeedButDispatchesToIMDCT. When the object count at this+0x20 is positive, loops that many times allocating a 256-byte buffer per object, zeroing it, storing it at object offset +80 of the array at *(this+0xC4), and marking the matching dispatch slot (state + 11, advanced per iteration) to -1. Returns the number of buffers allocated.

local_names.result: allocated dispatch state pointer; later reused as the loop counter and returned
local_names.v3: dispatch slot pointer advanced through the state block (state + 11 + iteration)
local_names.v5: destination pointer at object offset +80 within the descriptor array
local_names.v7: running destination pointer, started at *(this+0xC4) + 80 and advanced by 84 per iteration

operations.description: Invoke allocator entry 0 from the vtable at this+0x4 with (this, 1, 84) to allocate an 84-byte dispatch state block.
Store the allocated dispatch state pointer at this+0x198.
Write FAILOverviewSaysFIRCrossfeedButDispatchesToIMDCT (0x0051BAD1) as entry 0 of the new dispatch state block.
Guard on the object count at this+0x20: only a positive count enters the per-object buffer allocation loop.
Loop v6 from 0 while v6 is less than the object count at this+0x20; each iteration strides the descriptor array destination by 84 bytes.
Within the loop, invoke allocator entry 0 again with (this, 1, 256) to allocate a 256-byte buffer for the current object.
Store the allocated buffer at object offset +80 (base *(this+0xC4), advanced by 84 per iteration).
Zero the 256-byte buffer with memset(0, 256); memset is named in the raw source only and carries no callee address evidence.
Initialize the corresponding dispatch slot (state pointer + 11, advanced per iteration) to -1 and advance the loop counter.
Return the loop counter, i.e. the number of buffers allocated.
Called by sub_516C7B during setup to allocate the combo-box per-object buffers.

unresolved: The allocator object at this+0x4 and the dispatch state's class are not identified by packet evidence.
The role of the -1 slot initialization and of FAILOverviewSaysFIRCrossfeedButDispatchesToIMDCT in the dispatch state is not established.
The object descriptor type at *(this+0xC4) and what its +80 field holds after initialization are unknown.
